title: Introducing The Cub House TroubleMakers Component Line Shakabsorber 26″ Fork
content:
In a world of an increasingly precarious bike industry, the Cub House knows it’s time to take some matters into its own hands. You’ve heard of Problem Solvers; now meet TroubleMakers, The Cub House’s newest division. The first launch is the Shakabsorber — its first offering!

The Shakabsorber™️ is a suspension-corrected 26er fork handmade in San Diego. Threaded eyelets, dynamo ports, fender + rack mounts, and offered in TM Blue, Hi Vis Ooze, Rattlecan Raw, and Black™️ 🤙🤙🤙🤙

Why a Rigid 26er Fork?

Steezy 26ers are a huge part of the Cub House, so we thought, why not make our own fork! We also wanted to be different, as there are some really cool options made by our friends out there. With a sprinkling of BMX inspo, these are made here in California by our buddy Sal, who made all the original SE Landing gear forks. Who better to make a fork in this style?

The troublemakers at TroubleMakers thought long and hard about measurements and stuff, but eventually they just prototyped some different forks to test out, and these measurements are the ones that rode the best. They landed on a 1 1/8″ steerer, 1 ½” suspension-corrected, 420 mm axle-to-crown, with a mid and lower rack mount, and fit 26 x 2.5 and probably bigger with ease!

There is internal dynamo wire routing, so it looks super clean if you want to run a light. There are 4 color options: Black, ™ Blue, Hi Vis, and Rattle Can Raw.

The first 3 are powder-coat finished; Rattle Can Raw is really gonna be Benny the Big Cat rattle-canning clear coat on your fork in the back of the shop. It looks rad, lasts great, and will patina over time.

TroubleMakers Shakabsorber Quick Hits

  • $320-$350 depending on color
  • 1 1/8″ Steerer
  • 100×9 mm Quick Release
  • 300 mm Threadless Steerer
  • Axle To Crown 420 mm
  • M5 Rack Mounts (Mid mount and lower mount)
  • Routing for Dynamo Wires
  • Brake Studs Included
  • Weight: about 3 lbs 6 ounces (plenty strong)
  • Made in the USA!
  • If you are outside the USA and want one of these, shoot TroubleMakes an email, and they can sort out getting ya one

Dropping along with some TroubleMakers soft goods TODAY at 10 AM PST, exclusively on Cubhouse.cc
